text.arabic_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector opening a new declarative frame after the prior threat
words.prose: The opening connector resumes rather than merely adds. It keeps 48:14 tied to the completed warning in 48:13 while reopening the discourse as a sovereignty declaration, and its light onset begins the ayah's sequence of audible resets.

topics.headline: resumptive warrant after prior threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah as a fresh declaration that grounds the warning of 48:13 instead of a loose continuation.
topics.reason: Local clause evidence supports a new nominal sovereignty frame after the prior ayah, while the connector preserves semantic continuity with 48:13.

topics.headline: fused opening beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the restart is attached to the possession phrase and begins a repeated beat pattern across the ayah.
topics.reason: The written proclitic and repeated connector pattern make the opening visually attached and rhythmically programmatic.

words.gloss_range: fronted possessive preposition marking exclusive ownership before the owned domain is named
words.prose: The preposition makes possession the first semantic move of the clause. Because the possessive predicate comes before the sovereignty noun, the reader meets exclusive divine ownership before the cosmic domain itself is named.

topics.headline: fronted exclusive possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ownership established first, so dominion is framed as belonging to God alone before its scope is unfolded.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the prepositional phrase as the fronted possessive predicate, supporting the exclusivity and entry-point payoff.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in genitive as the identified possessor of cosmic dominion
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with worship and refuge associations; derivational alternatives color the name but do not replace the proper-name function here
words.prose: The genitive proper name fixes the possessor as the named divine referent, not a generic royal role. Its opening placement makes divine identity the frame for sovereignty, while the derivational worship and refuge background remains a narrowed coloring rather than a separate local sense. The same name also joins the Surah 48 sovereignty rhythm at 48:4, 48:7, and 48:14.

topics.headline: identified genitive possessor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that cosmic dominion is assigned to a specific named possessor, with case marking making that role grammatical.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the name in genitive, and the proper noun definiteness prevents a generic possessor reading.

topics.headline: divine-name semantic background
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps worship, refuge, and awe in the background of the name without making those derivations override its proper-name role.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is meaningful as coloring, but local grammar selects the proper divine name as possessor.

topics.headline: surah-local cosmic frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the name and heavens-earth claim as part of a repeated sovereignty pattern in 48:4, 48:7, and 48:14.
topics.reason: Distributional evidence supports the stable association of the divine name with the cosmic pair, and the rows give concrete Surah 48 recurrence.

words.gloss_range: sovereign dominion over a governed cosmic domain, not mere owned property
words.root_gloss_range: root range spans possession, rule, firmness, ownership, kingly authority, subjection, and several unrelated lexical branches; the local noun selects sovereign rule over the heavens-earth domain
words.prose: The noun names operative sovereignty over a governed domain. Its construct form binds the following cosmic pair to the dominion claim, the vowel shape narrows the sense away from mere property, and a reported plural reading remains apparatus rather than the local parse. Compared with 3:129, this wording stresses dominion over the heavens-earth domain rather than only what is in it, so sovereignty stands before the later acts of forgiveness and punishment.

topics.headline: construct-bound dominion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees dominion as a specific construct claim over the known heavens-earth domain, not a free-floating abstraction.
topics.reason: The iḍāfa relation is syntactically forced, and the local noun belongs to the sovereignty branch of the root.

topics.headline: vowel-shaped sovereignty, variant kept limited
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local form points to governing authority, while the reported variant only pressures multiplicity and does not displace the base reading.
topics.reason: The canonical local surface selects the dominion noun; the reported reading is useful apparatus but not the governing parse.

topics.headline: formula grounds the act pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the forgiveness-punishment dyad as grounded in a cosmic sovereignty formula rather than as detached acts.
topics.reason: The nominal sovereignty clause precedes the two verbs, and the row evidence compares the fixed formula with 3:129 and the Surah 48 frame.

words.gloss_range: definite plural elevated realms as the upper half of the cosmic domain
words.root_gloss_range: height and elevation field, with marking/name associations kept as background; locally the plural noun selects the known upper realms
words.prose: The word supplies the raised, plural upper domain of the dominion claim. Its definiteness and plural form make the scope known and layered, while the following earth term completes the upper-lower totality. The same heavens-earth pair marks the Surah 48 sovereignty rhythm at 48:4, 48:7, and 48:14.

topics.headline: definite raised plural domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the heavens as the recognized layered upper realm included under dominion, not a vague sky.
topics.reason: The genitive plural is attached to the sovereignty noun, and the lexical evidence supports elevation as the local image.

topics.headline: upper pole of totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the heavens-earth pair as a standard totality marker, reinforced in 48:4, 48:7, and 48:14.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and local coordination evidence support the upper-lower merism rather than two unrelated locations.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that completes the heavens-earth pair
words.prose: This connector joins the lower pole to the upper one inside the same possessive phrase. Its payoff is small but structural: dominion is not left over the heavens alone, because the connector completes the high-low merism. It also helps carry the Surah 48 progression from hosts in 48:4 and 48:7 to dominion in 48:14 as the pair is completed.

topics.headline: coordinator completes the cosmic pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the earth term as grammatically bound into the same sovereignty phrase, completing total scope.
topics.reason: The conjunction is locally a coordinated attachment from the heavens noun to the earth noun.

topics.headline: Surah 48 progression marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect 48:14 with 48:4 and 48:7, where the same cosmic pair moves from hosts to dominion.
topics.reason: The row gives concrete Surah 48 references for a progression from hosts to kingdom language.

words.gloss_range: definite earth-domain as the lower pole of the total cosmic merism
words.root_gloss_range: ground, breadth, lowness, land, and earth-domain range; the local pair selects total lower realm rather than a local territory
words.prose: The word closes the first beat by grounding the cosmic pair in the definite lower domain. In coordination with the heavens, it selects the whole earth-domain, not a local territory, so sovereignty extends above and below without exception. That closure resumes the same Surah 48 cosmic frame at 48:4, 48:7, and 48:14.

topics.headline: definite grounded lower pole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the earth as the whole known lower domain, not one land among others.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and genitive by coordination, and the cosmic pair narrows the root range to total earth-domain.

topics.headline: earth completes totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first movement close as a totalizing upper-lower formula, recurring in 48:4, 48:7, and 48:14.
topics.reason: The earth-heavens pairing is dominant in the profile evidence and is explicitly tied by the rows to Surah 48 recurrence.

words.gloss_range: imperfect divine act of protective covering directed toward a recipient
words.root_gloss_range: covering, shielding, concealment, pardon, and forgiveness range; here the protective-covering branch is active as divine forgiveness
words.prose: The verb presents forgiveness as an active, open act of protective covering. The omitted forgiven object leaves the recipient in focus, and the later intensive attribute turns this same covering action into a statement of divine character. Across the boundary from 48:13, protective covering answers the failed or negative covering associated with unbelief.

topics.headline: recipient-focused ongoing covering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar foregrounds who receives covering while leaving the forgiven object implicit.
topics.reason: The local clause uses a beneficiary phrase and ellipsis evidence supplies the omitted object, so the recipient remains foregrounded.

topics.headline: protective covering image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears forgiveness as shielding or covering, which reverses the negative covering associated with unbelief in 48:13.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports protective covering, and the boundary rows tie that image to 48:13.

topics.headline: act flows into attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the act of forgiving move forward into the closing attribute, so action becomes character within the ayah.
topics.reason: The same root appears as verb and later as intensive adjective, and the formula parallels 3:129 while being grounded here in dominion.

words.gloss_range: benefactive preposition marking forgiveness as given for a recipient
words.prose: The preposition makes the first relative phrase benefactive. Against the later bare object, forgiveness is grammatically routed as something for someone, not merely an action imposed on someone.

topics.headline: benefactive contrast before relative pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that forgiveness is given for a recipient, while punishment later contacts its object directly.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the phrase as beneficiary of the forgiveness verb, and the parallel clause lacks this preposition.

words.gloss_range: open relative pronoun for the forgiveness recipient, not a conditional marker
words.prose: The pronoun keeps the recipient class open without making an if-then condition. It cannot finish the phrase by itself; it waits for the following will verb, so human identity remains unspecified until divine willing completes the clause.

topics.headline: open relative recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah withholds criteria and makes the recipient phrase structurally depend on divine willing.
topics.reason: The local parse is relative rather than conditional, and the following will clause completes the phrase.

words.gloss_range: imperfect divine willing that completes and governs the forgiveness recipient clause
words.root_gloss_range: will, choosing, and thingness range; locally the verb governs selection without naming the criteria
words.prose: The verb completes the open recipient phrase and makes divine willing the selection point. Its imperfect form keeps the selection active, while the root background links willing with making a thing actual; the closing sound gives the otherwise open category a decisive stop.

topics.headline: will completes the recipient clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees forgiveness governed by the same active divine will that will return at the punishment clause ending.
topics.reason: The verb supplies the predicate of the relative clause and sets the repeated will frame.

topics.headline: actualizing will with decisive closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears an open act of choosing that remains unspecified in criteria but is decisive in its closure.
topics.reason: The thingness derivation is meaningful as semantic background, while the local verb simply governs divine selection.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that adds the second divine act as a paired prerogative
words.prose: The connector adds punishment as the paired second act without subordinating it to forgiveness. It holds the opposed verbs together while still allowing the second verb to keep its own direct-object frame.

topics.headline: coordinated opposed acts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees forgiveness and punishment held as coordinated prerogatives under one sovereignty frame, not as a flat or collapsed verb list.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the punishment verb with the forgiveness verb while preserving separate object frames.

words.gloss_range: Form II imperfect punishment verb: direct, causative-imposed consequence under divine will
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes sweetness, palatable water, deprivation, and punishment; local Form II plus direct object selects causative punishment while retaining deprivation pressure
words.prose: The verb makes consequence an active imposed state. Its Form II doubling and direct object make the impact sharper than the benefactive forgiveness clause, while the sweetness-deprivation root background narrows into punishment rather than replacing it. It also supplies the governing act that can apply the prepared consequence named at the end of 48:13.

topics.headline: direct impact against benefactive forgiveness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that punishment reaches the person directly, while forgiveness was grammatically marked as for the recipient.
topics.reason: The local object relation is direct, and the paired clauses contrast the missing beneficiary preposition.

topics.headline: causative deprivation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses punishment as active deprivation imposed on the person, while Form II grammar keeps punishment as the selected local sense.
topics.reason: The sweetness branch is not the local sense, but the root tension usefully colors the selected Form II causative punishment.

topics.headline: sovereign consequence thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the verb to the prepared consequence of 48:13 as the governing act that can apply it.
topics.reason: The row evidence ties the punishment root to nearby consequence language and specifically to the prepared fire of 48:13.

words.gloss_range: bare relative pronoun as direct object of punishment, contrasted with the earlier benefactive phrase
words.prose: The pronoun is bare and direct here. It repeats the open relative structure of the forgiveness clause, but without the benefactive preposition, so the sound is parallel while the relational force is harsher and more immediate. The move from the named threatened class in 48:13 to this open relative keeps selection under divine will rather than under a stated criterion inside the clause.

topics.headline: bare direct-object relative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second human object as open and will-governed, but exposed directly to the punishment verb rather than mediated by benefit.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the pronoun as direct object, and the rows contrast it with the earlier benefactive phrase.

words.gloss_range: repeated imperfect divine willing that closes the punishment clause symmetrically
words.root_gloss_range: will and actualization range; locally the repeated verb governs the harsher pole without supplying criteria
words.prose: The repeated will verb closes the second clause with the same form used for forgiveness. That repetition makes opposite outcomes share one governing will, while the ayah still withholds the criteria for either selection.

topics.headline: one will-form seals both outcomes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears mercy and punishment end on the same choosing verb, so the dyad is symmetrical in governance though opposite in outcome.
topics.reason: The second will clause completes the direct-object relative, repeats the same form, and preserves the unstated basis of selection.

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector opening the attribute coda after the act pair
words.prose: The connector opens a new coda rather than adding a third act. It lets the forgiveness-punishment dyad close and then shifts the reader from what God does to the enduring attribute formula that explains how the dyad should be framed. After the engaged threat of 48:13, this coda settles into third-person declarative theology.

topics.headline: resumptive coda after the act pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final clause as an explanatory attribute coda, not another item in the list of divine acts.
topics.reason: The clause type changes to a kāna clause, so the connector resumes with a being formula after the paired verbs.

words.gloss_range: perfect copular being verb introducing timeless divine attributes rather than a past event
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, existence, place, surety, and condition branches; local defective copular grammar selects identity attribution
words.prose: The verb is formally perfect, but in this divine attribute formula it asserts established being rather than a past change. It links the named subject to two predicates, turning the prior acts into a coda about enduring divine character. As part of the Surah 48 refrain at 48:4, 48:5, 48:7, and 48:14, the formula moves the reader from unknown selection to a stable attribute frame.

topics.headline: perfect form as timeless copula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not read the attributes as something God became; the perfect form gives them established, timeless force.
topics.reason: The local kāna frame is defective/copular with subject and predicates, not a complete existence event.

topics.headline: act pair reframed by attribute seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader moves from unknown selection in the will clauses to the known divine character named by abundant covering and intimate mercy.
topics.reason: The kāna formula follows the specific acts and generalizes them through the closing attribute pair.

words.gloss_range: nominative proper divine name as the explicit subject of the attribute formula
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with worship and awe associations; locally the proper noun is the nominative subject of the copula
words.prose: The nominative name makes the subject of the attribute coda explicit. The same divine name that opened as possessor now stands as the subject of being, framing the ayah from ownership to enduring attributes.

topics.headline: explicit subject of timeless attributes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the attributes predicated directly of the named divine referent, not left to an implied subject from the verbs.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the name as ism kāna, positioned between the being verb and the two attributes.

topics.headline: name bookends the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah enclosed by the same name: genitive possessor at the opening and nominative subject at the close.
topics.reason: The case shift from opening possessor to closing subject is local grammar, and the rows identify the bookend pattern.

words.gloss_range: accusative intensive covering attribute, first predicate of the closing pair
words.root_gloss_range: covering, shielding, concealment, and forgiveness range; the local faʿūl adjective selects abundant protective-covering attribute
words.prose: The adjective turns the earlier covering act into an abundant attribute. Its accusative predicate form binds it to the copular clause, and its first position prepares the final mercy word rather than closing the ayah by itself. At the boundary with 48:13, protective covering stands against the preceding fire image before mercy receives the final position.

topics.headline: intensive covering predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees forgiveness not only as an act God does, but as an abundant quality asserted of God.
topics.reason: The form is an accusative kāna predicate and an intensive adjective, preserving the protective-covering root image.

topics.headline: forgiveness act becomes essence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the earlier forgiveness verb gathered into the closing theological seal as stable character.
topics.reason: The same root appears in the earlier verb and the closing adjective, with the coda position converting act into attribute.

words.gloss_range: accusative qualitative mercy attribute completing the closing pair in final position
words.root_gloss_range: mercy, womb-care, tenderness, and protective nurture range; the local faʿīl adjective selects intimate mercifulness as the final attribute
words.prose: The final adjective completes the paired predicate and leaves mercy as the ayah's last semantic and acoustic residue. Its form selects intimate mercy, and the womb-care background makes the closure concrete: after sovereignty and punishment, protective tenderness has the final word.

topics.headline: intimate mercy predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the chosen form points to specific, intimate mercy, while broader mercy-family associations remain supporting background.
topics.reason: The word is the second accusative kāna predicate; the faʿīl form is local, while womb and broader mercy-family evidence color the selected attribute.

topics.headline: mercy has the final word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears mercy, not punishment, as the last retained quality after the sovereignty and will-governed dyad.
topics.reason: The row evidence ties final position, paired cadence, later Surah 48 mercy contexts, and the contrast with 48:13 into the closure payoff.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction wa-li-llahi mulku al-samawati wa-al-ard at 48:14:1-4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mulk can name not only title or possession but the strength, cohesion, and load-bearing mainstay by which an order stands. The elevated heavens and the low earth stretch that holding across the full vertical field. Sovereignty is therefore pictured as continuous maintenance of a coherent domain, not merely a claim over it.

activation_trace.role: The image of strength and cohesion makes mulk the force that keeps the cosmic order from coming apart.
The image of an affair's mainstay gives sovereignty a load-bearing rather than merely honorific function.
Elevation supplies the upper pole of the field held by that sovereignty.
The low ground opposite heaven supplies the lower pole, making the claimed span exhaustive.

changed_reading.before: God possesses the heavens and earth as their sovereign owner.
changed_reading.after: The entire high-to-low order is held together by God's operative sovereignty; forgiveness and punishment occur inside a continuously sustained field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence yaghfiru, yu'adhdhibu, kana, ghafuran rahiman at 48:14:5-14.
baseline_models.mechanism: Forgiveness supplies protective covering and protection from a fault's effect, while punishment supplies real pain. Yet the two finite options do not receive symmetric closing names: the verse settles into an established state of abundant covering and tender care. Punishment remains live, but the final characterization encloses the pair within a merciful disposition.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering turns forgiveness from mere cancellation into preservation from exposure and damage.
Covering a fault and shielding its bearer from its effect anchors the ordinary moral action.
Pain and penalty keep the punitive clause fully real rather than dissolving it into mercy.
An occurring and present state lets kana mark an established disposition, not a closed past episode.
Tenderness and beneficent care provide the verse's final relational orientation.

changed_reading.before: The verse balances two equally weighted sovereign options, pardon and punishment.
changed_reading.after: Punishment remains a real sovereign possibility, but the verse's lasting horizon is protective covering and care, so the balance is deliberately asymmetrical.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled man yasha'u at 48:14:6-10 within the domain introduced by mulk.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch field of shay' links willing to the thing willed and, more distantly, to carrying something into an affair. Read with mulk as effective disposition, the repeated formula can describe actual allocation and realization within a governed domain, rather than an unconditioned mood. The focus alone still leaves the criteria unstated.

activation_trace.role: Will attached to bringing about or attaining a thing makes each clause an act of realization.
The more distant image of carrying or compelling toward an affair suggests movement into an assigned outcome.
Possession with effective disposition supplies the jurisdiction in which willing becomes allocation.

changed_reading.before: Whom He wills is an opaque declaration of unrestricted preference.
changed_reading.after: Whom He wills can also mark the sovereign realization and placement of persons into distinct outcomes, while the focus ayah by itself does not disclose the selection mechanism.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening announces release from closure; its purpose chain then places forgiveness across what went before and what came after, followed by completion and guidance. This activates forgiveness in 48:14 as an opening of blocked temporal continuity: covered liability no longer prevents a course from reaching completion.

activation_trace.role: Protection from a fault's effect is the focus action whose temporal range is changed by the context.
A closed obstruction opening into a wider entrance supplies the release mechanism.
The context explicitly makes protective forgiveness a purpose of the opening.
What advanced before supplies the forward temporal side of the liability being covered.
What is delayed until later supplies the other temporal side, extending the opening beyond one past instant.
Arrival at completion supplies the downstream result made possible once obstruction is covered.

structural_cues: 48:1's opening is immediately followed by a purpose clause beginning with forgiveness in 48:2.
The prior/later pair is followed by completion of favor and guidance along a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, forgiveness, prior and later liability, then completion; I infer that covering the liability opens continuity toward completion. A live alternative is that these are parallel benefits with no causal dependence among them.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness removes or conceals a selected offense.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness also reopens a temporally blocked course, covering liabilities on both sides so an unfinished trajectory can continue to completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-identical cosmic ownership formula in 48:4 is recast as God's armies, directly after tranquility is delivered into hearts and faith grows. This permits a non-militarized army reading: the sovereign domain contains subtle, coordinated forces that still motion, settle inwardly, and increase trust. Mulk in 48:14 becomes a repertoire of effective agencies, not only external command.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty and rule are the focus anchor revised from static title into deployable agency.
Delivering something downward supplies the direction by which sovereign action reaches the interior.
The cessation of motion makes tranquility an effective force that changes a heart's dynamics.
The heart supplies the interior theater in which that force operates.
Growth supplies the measurable result of inward settling rather than battlefield coercion.
A mutually supporting host turns the cosmic domain into coordinated agencies available to sovereignty.

structural_cues: 48:4 places descending tranquility, hearts, and increase immediately before wa-li-llahi junudu al-samawati wa-al-ard.
48:7 repeats the armies formula, while 48:14 substitutes mulk in the same cosmic frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an inward action followed by the armies formula; I infer that tranquility can exemplify, without exhausting, the domain's coordinated forces. The live alternative is that the army clause refers only to a separate reserve of agents and does not classify tranquility.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic kingship authorizes externally imposed pardon or punishment.
changed_reading.after: Cosmic kingship also commands quiet inward agencies: one mode of sovereign action is to settle hearts and grow trust rather than overpower bodies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier punishment clause is followed by hostile supposition, an evil circuit upon its bearers, and expulsion into distance. This makes one punitive mechanism recursive: a construal that cannot trust its outcome closes into a circuit and returns upon the construler. Punishment is still God's judgment, but the context gives it feedback structure rather than depicting a detached blow.

activation_trace.role: Painful penalty is the focus outcome whose causal texture is revised by the return sequence.
The explicit contextual punishment ties that focus outcome to the sequence that follows.
Doubtful imagining supplies the inward construal from which the loop begins.
Circling and enclosure turn evil from a straight projectile into something that comes around upon its bearers.
The adverse circuit or defeat names the returned consequence within that enclosure.
Expulsion and distancing supply the loop's terminal social and relational condition.

structural_cues: 48:6 begins with punishment and identifies those who hold an evil supposition about God.
The phrase 'upon them is the evil circuit' gives the adverse result an explicit returning geometry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies punishment, hostile supposition, a circuit upon its bearers, and distancing; I infer a feedback arrow from construal to enclosing consequence. A live alternative is a non-causal list of traits and separately imposed verdicts.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is an externally selected pain whose relation to the punished person's inner stance is unspecified.
changed_reading.after: One coexisting punitive reading is a divinely judged return loop: hostile construal circles back, encloses its bearer, and hardens into distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pledge scene models sovereignty as a maintained relation. A binding exchange is made with God; unravelling it returns against the agent's own self, while keeping it whole matures into reward. This gives the focus alternatives a covenantal pathway in which divine disposition and human response are not competitors.

activation_trace.role: Effective possession and disposition anchor the covenant inside sovereign jurisdiction.
The pledge of obedience supplies a reciprocal bond rather than a one-way decree.
Unravelling a tightly made covenant supplies the agent's disruptive action.
The very self makes breach reflexive: the broken relation returns upon the breaker.
Wholeness without deficiency supplies the opposite path of preserving the relation.
A guarded covenant that gives security supplies the durable structure joining pledge and outcome.

structural_cues: 48:10 identifies the pledge to the messenger as a pledge to God.
Its two branches are explicit: breach is against oneself, while fulfillment receives reward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sovereign party, a reciprocal pledge, self-returning breach, and rewarded fulfillment; I infer that this relation can mediate the alternatives named in 48:14. A live alternative is that the pledge scene specifies only one historical group and should not texture the general statement.

changed_reading.before: Sovereign will and human agency stand on opposite sides of the verse.
changed_reading.after: They can coexist within covenant: sovereign disposition establishes the bond, while keeping or unravelling it shapes an outcome that returns to the participant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The laggards say their wealth and households occupied them, then the text asks who can possess any power for them against God in harm or benefit. The irony reverses ownership: people invoke what they own, but those possessions have already occupied their attention and conduct. The focus declaration of cosmic mulk exposes both the rival mastery of possessions and the impossibility of an insulating counter-domain.

activation_trace.role: Possession with power of disposition is the focus claim set against the laggards' smaller claims.
Occupation as the opposite of available space makes possessions function as masters of attention.
Acquired and accumulated wealth supplies the supposed possession that performs the occupying.
The question about possessing anything against God explicitly negates an independent protective jurisdiction.
Loss and impairment supply one endpoint no rival possession can intercept.
Benefit supplies the opposite endpoint, showing that the negated counter-power spans both directions.

structural_cues: 48:11 moves from 'our wealth occupied us' to 'who possesses for you anything against God.'
The request for forgiveness is spoken by tongues while the text denies correspondence in hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies possessions as grammatical occupiers and then negates counter-possession against God; I infer an intentional reversal in which owners become owned by their excuses. A live alternative is that 'occupied us' is only a conventional excuse with no ownership irony.

changed_reading.before: God's cosmic ownership is a scale claim larger than human property.
changed_reading.after: It also diagnoses false mastery: what humans claim to own can occupy and govern them, while no such possession creates a refuge outside God's field of harm, benefit, or forgiveness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly places good outcome after willing compliance and painful punishment after turning away, then interrupts the rule to remove constriction from blindness, lameness, and illness. The repeated 'whom He wills' in the focus can therefore coexist with responsive and capacity-sensitive governance: consequence tracks orientation, but liability is not flattened across unequal ability.

activation_trace.role: Divine willing is the focus hinge whose apparent opacity is qualified by contextual branching.
Punitive pain is the focus outcome attached by context to turning away.
Responsive compliance supplies the positive branch of the contextual decision structure.
Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the opposed orientation that precedes punishment.
The painful consequence explicitly follows the turning branch rather than appearing as an unlinked lottery.
Removed constriction supplies a capacity exception inside the otherwise repeated response rule.
Impaired motion makes the exemption functionally about reduced capacity, not favored identity.

structural_cues: 48:16 and 48:17 each contrast compliance with turning away and attach punishment only to the latter branch.
48:17 first exempts three embodied limitations from haraj before restating the two outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conditional response clauses and explicit capacity exemptions; I infer that these locally reveal how sovereign willing may be administered. A live alternative is that 48:14 intentionally remains more general than these particular commands and should not be reduced to them.

changed_reading.before: The doubled will formula sounds indifferent to response and individual capacity.
changed_reading.after: Within the surah's local mechanics, sovereign willing can issue as response-sensitive and capacity-calibrated judgment, without exhausting the focus statement's wider freedom.

context_deltas.mechanism: An unattained outcome is already encompassed, and the divine sunnah is a running path for which no substitution will be found. These cues strengthen kana in the focus as stable operative continuity. Mulk includes what agents cannot yet reach, while forgiveness and punishment belong to a durable pattern rather than intermittent reactions.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty anchors the claim that inaccessible outcomes remain within divine jurisdiction.
Occurrence and presence in time let kana carry continuity into the focus's closing characterization.
Complete enclosure in knowledge and possession places the currently unreachable inside an already held perimeter.
A running path and followed practice supply regularity across different events.
The denial that one thing can replace another blocks the reading of the pattern as ad hoc or disposable.

structural_cues: 48:21 joins inability to reach an outcome with God's already encompassing it.
48:23 repeats sunnah and denies any replacement for it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies encompassing power and an unreplaced running pattern; I infer that the focus's kana names a continuously operative character within that pattern. A live alternative is that kana is only formulaic predication and the sunnah concerns victory alone.

changed_reading.before: The closing 'God was forgiving, merciful' can sound like a retrospective attribute after two present acts.
changed_reading.after: It can mark a durable mode of rule: even unreached outcomes are already encompassed, and judgment operates through a continuous, non-substituted pattern.

context_deltas.mechanism: After victory, opposing hands are withheld. The next scene reveals unrecognized believers mixed among opponents: immediate force would trample them and stain the actors with unintended harm. Mercy admits while populations remain intermingled; punishment becomes executable only under the counterfactual of separation. Sovereign will is thus activated as informed restraint under hidden complexity, not simple failure to exercise power.

activation_trace.role: Merciful care is the focus disposition given a concrete protective operation by the mixed-population scene.
Punitive force is the focus possibility whose timing is revised by hidden intermixture.
Active withholding supplies the sovereign operation that prevents force despite achieved advantage.
What is disclosed to the knower but not to the actors creates the information asymmetry requiring restraint.
Crushing pressure supplies the collateral mechanism that unchecked advance would produce.
A stain of harm supplies the unintended moral residue that restraint prevents.
Admission into merciful care explicitly names protection as the purpose operating in the mixed field.
Differentiating and separating supplies the stated counterfactual condition for targeted punishment.
The split root's second inventory independently reinforces separation and discrimination between mixed elements.
Punishment appears inside an if-separated counterfactual, making discrimination a condition of its clean execution.

structural_cues: 48:24 explicitly attributes mutual hand-restraint to God after advantage had been granted.
48:25 makes unknown believers and unintended injury the reason immediate force is withheld, then states punishment only in the counterfactual of separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, hidden intermixture, collateral pressure, mercy, and a separation counterfactual; I infer that informed non-action is itself an exercise of mulk and rahmah. A live alternative is that the mercy clause concerns eventual conversion while the military restraint has only an unrelated treaty purpose.

changed_reading.before: Whom He forgives and whom He punishes presents immediate bilateral freedom to act on isolated individuals.
changed_reading.after: Sovereign freedom can appear as delayed differentiation: mercy holds a mixed field together and restrains executable punishment until hidden innocents can be protected from collateral harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close of the surah places mutual mercy beside a crop that sends out shoots, supports them, thickens, and stands upright, then promises forgiveness. This activates ghafur rahim as a developmental medium: protective covering and reciprocal care do not merely erase a prior defect; they allow vulnerable extensions to emerge, support one another, and become load-bearing.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering supplies the environmental shelter under which damaged or young growth can persist.
Tender care supplies the relational medium later embodied as mercy among the group.
Mercy among participants turns the divine attribute into a reproduced social relation.
Cultivation and growth supply the overall developmental mechanism rather than a courtroom-only model.
A shoot emerging around the original stem makes new members vulnerable extensions rather than finished units.
Plants strengthening through mutual support gives mercy a concrete load-sharing function.
Upright completion supplies the mature result of protection and mutual strengthening.
The final promise explicitly reconnects the growth image to forgiveness and protection from fault's effect.

structural_cues: 48:29 first describes the group as merciful among themselves, then renders them as one developing crop.
The crop's sequence ends near the surah's promise of forgiveness and great reward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mutual mercy, staged plant development, and a closing promise of forgiveness; I infer that mercy and forgiveness function as conditions of durable communal growth. A live alternative is that the crop image concerns numerical strength alone and the promise is only appended reward.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness repairs a completed moral past, and mercy is benevolent feeling toward separate persons.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness and mercy can be future-forming ecology: they protect emerging shoots, circulate as mutual support, and let a fragile collective become upright without erasing its plurality.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it follows the packet's non-dominant mapping from the root tagged for 'heavens' into the field of visible marking, not the ordinary lexical sense of al-samawat. It remains valid as a branch echo anchored at 48:14:3 and coheres with the explicitly fertile earth branch at 48:14:4. Downstream prose should call it a cross-mapped signaling image, never a replacement translation of 'heavens.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacent focus words al-samawat and al-ard, followed by yaghfiru.

activation_trace.role: A visible mark that identifies its bearer activates the upper field as a source of legible signs.
First rain marking earth with vegetation links the upper field to a receiving and visibly changed surface.
Soft fertile ground supplies the receptive lower surface on which an unseen descent becomes visible growth.
Covering introduces a counter-operation to marking: sovereign action may conceal a trace as well as make one visible.

changed_reading.before: Heavens and earth name the two spatial halves of God's territory.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch echo, they also form a signaling ecology: what comes from above marks a receptive earth, while forgiveness names sovereign power to cover a damaging trace.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form yu'adhdhibu most directly activates painful punishment, while the same inventory's withholding or weaning branch is form-distant. It remains anchored in that exact focus root and is independently activated by God's explicit withholding of hands before collateral crushing in 48:24-25. Downstream prose must retain inflicted punishment as primary and present restraint only as a secondary punitive-governance mechanism.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yu'adhdhibu at 48:14:8, read beside the packet's withholding sequence at 48:24-25.

activation_trace.role: Pain and penalty preserve the primary force of the focus verb and contain the exploratory extension.
Withholding, preventing, or weaning activates a secondary way punitive authority can interrupt a harmful course.
Explicit divine prevention of hands supplies a context-level analogue for authority exercised by restraint.
Crushing pressure identifies the harmful motion that sovereign withholding interrupts.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is only the positive infliction of pain.
changed_reading.after: Without cancelling that primary sense, punitive sovereignty may also work by withholding, weaning, or arresting motion when unrestrained action would produce indiscriminate harm.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the anatomical womb branch beneath rahim and rahmah. It remains visibly anchored in the focus's final rahiman and gains spatial support from 48:25, where mercy contains people who are still hidden within an undifferentiated population and punishment waits for separation. Downstream prose should present womb-like containment as a material analogy for delayed differentiation, not as the lexical gloss of divine mercy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Rahiman at 48:14:14, with the exact mercy-and-separation construction in 48:25.

activation_trace.role: The womb as a protected generative container supplies the outlier's material model of mercy.
Entry into mercy while persons remain hidden among others gives the container image a direct contextual anchor.
Hidden identity known to one party but not the actors explains why the container cannot yet be opened by force.
Separation and differentiation name the counterfactual end of the containing phase.
The alternate mapped inventory reinforces differentiation as the condition that has not yet arrived.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is favorable treatment bestowed on already distinct recipients.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, mercy can be a womb-like interval that protects still-hidden persons within a mixed body and postpones violent differentiation until separation is possible.

strongest_changes: Mulk shifted from static cosmic title to the cohesion, repertoire, and restraint by which a complex domain is actually governed.
The doubled will formula remained sovereign but acquired responsive, capacity-sensitive, covenantal, and information-sensitive mechanisms from the context.
Punishment developed two coexisting textures: a hostile construal returning as an enclosing circuit, and targeted force delayed to prevent collateral injury.
Forgiveness changed from retrospective cancellation into temporal reopening, protective covering, and a future-forming medium for collective growth.
Rahmah acquired a contained spatial reading: mercy can hold an intermixed field together until clean differentiation is possible.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activation came from preserving asymmetry and non-action. The focus names both forgiveness and punishment, yet closes only with covering and mercy; later context then makes withheld force, hidden intermixture, and organic mutual support positive exercises of sovereignty. Split-root and form-distant branches added marked-surface, restraint, and womb-like models that should coexist as qualified echoes rather than replace ordinary senses.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus ayah itself does not state selection criteria, so contextual response rules illuminate but do not exhaust man yasha'u.
Calling tranquility one of the cosmic armies is an abductive link from sequence and parallel formula, not an explicit identification.
The marked-sky, withholding, and womb-like readings depend on non-dominant or form-distant branch activation and require explicit exploratory containment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Sovereignty as complete control of covering and exposure.** `ملك` anchors م ل ك B002 (ownership/disposal) and B003 (dominion); heavens and earth again supply the vertical totality. `يغفر` anchors غ ف ر B001/B002, while `يعذب` anchors ع ذ ب B005 and B003 (punishment; withholding). I infer that dominion is exercised by disposing protective cover and deprivation across the whole field. The alternatives are governmental operations, not disconnected moods.
2. **Mercy preserves a route back through the binary.** The close `غفورًا رحيمًا` reasserts غ ف ر B002 and ر ح م B001, with B002/B003’s belonging/womb imagery activated by 48:25 and 48:29. Structurally, mercy follows both forgiveness and punishment rather than only the first. I infer that the closing attributes keep protective inclusion conceptually available without erasing the punitive branch. The ayah ends with a bias toward restored shelter while preserving both outcomes.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 48:25 makes mercy newly spatial: persons are admitted into it while hidden intermixture blocks punishment. Dominion in 48:14 is therefore seen exercising precise protective discrimination.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Dominion as effective disposal, not a decorative preface.** Fixed `مُلْك` anchors م ل ك `B002` (ownership and disposal) and `B003` (kingship and dominion). Ayah 48:11 has asked who can control any harm or benefit against God; 48:15 exposes desire to acquire gains; 48:18-19 allocate approval, opening, and gains. These are packet-supplied claims and distributions; I infer **exclusive disposal -> authority to allocate both shielding and consequence**. The opening clause causally governs the two following verbs rather than merely magnifying their subject.

2. **Forgiveness and mercy as protective re-housing.** Fixed غ ف ر activates `B001`, protective covering, and fixed ر ح م activates the `B003` womb image alongside tenderness in `B001`. Ayah 48:17 supplies entry into tree-covered gardens, and 48:18 supplies shelter beneath a tree plus tranquility laid upon the believers. The packet supplies covering and inhabited enclosures; I infer **liability covered -> recipient placed inside a life-preserving interior**. `غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا` reads as a two-stage protection: exposure is removed and belonging is restored.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayat 48:17-18 changed the closing attributes most: garden entry, shelter under a tree, and descended tranquility made covering plus womb-like enclosure read as protective re-housing. Ayat 48:18-19 also confirmed that fixed `ملك` governs concrete allocations rather than merely asserting rank.

baseline.text: Göklerin ve yerin egemenliği Allah'ındır. O dilediğini bağışlar, dilediğine azap eder. Allah çok bağışlayandır, çok merhametlidir.

findings.text: Egemenlik, bütün alanda koruyucu örtüyü verme ya da geri çekme yetkisiyle işleyen etkin bir yönetimdir.
Bağışlama ile merhamet birlikte, açıkta kalan sorumluluğu örttükten sonra kişiyi yeniden koruyucu bir aidiyet alanına yerleştiren iki aşamalı bir dönüş yolu kurar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tapınma eylemini ve bu eylemin yöneldiği varlığı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin tapınma eylemini veya kendini tapınmaya vermesini bildiren eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylem olarak tapınma çekirdeğini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun kendisine tapındığı varlık veya nesneden söz edilen ad bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tapınmanın yöneldiği varlık veya nesne anlamını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir varlığı tapınma konusu durumuna getirme işlemini korur.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi elinde bulundurma ve üzerinde hükme bağlı tasarruf yetkisi taşıma çekirdeğini açıkça kurar; malın başkasına geçirilmesi, köleleştirilmiş kişi, bu kişilere davranış ve boşanma kararının eşe bırakılması bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal özel sahiplik ve tasarruf yetkisidir; halk üzerinde kamusal yönetim ve saltanat ayrı bir daldır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel sahiplik çekirdeği ile el altında bulundurma, kölelik, iyi muamele ve boşanma yetkisini devretme gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmadan tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin bir kişinin elinde veya hukuki alanında bulunması ve o kişinin onun üzerinde tasarruf yetkisi taşımasıdır. Bu yetki devredilebilir; tarihsel kullanımlarda köleleştirilmiş kişileri ve onlara ilişkin davranışı, belirli bir kalıpta ise boşanma kararının eşe bırakılmasını da kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir kişi, mal veya hak üzerinde sahiplikten doğan elinde bulundurma ve tasarruf yetkisine sahiptir.
Sahiplik bir başkasına geçirilebilir veya belirli bir konuda karar yetkisi o kişiye bırakılabilir.
Tarihsel kullanımda sahip olunan kişi, köleleştirilmiş insanı ve ona ilişkin sahiplik durumunu belirtir.
Belirli bir kalıp, sahibin köleleştirilmiş kişilere iyi davranmasını ifade eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, sahipliği bir şeyin elde veya hukuki denetimde bulunması ve üzerinde hükme bağlı tasarruf kurulması olarak birleştirir; devir, kölelik ve özel karar yetkisi bu ilişkinin tarihsel ya da kalıplaşmış uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Mal, hak ve kişi üzerinde kurulan özel sahiplik ilişkisini ve bundan doğan işlem yetkisini kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Elde bulundurma, hukuki aidiyet ve tasarruf yetkisini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir mal veya hakkın kişiye ait olduğu ve onun tasarrufunda bulunduğu genel bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Aidiyet ve kişisel denetim çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yetki devri ile tarihsel kölelik ve özel davranış kullanımlarını açıkça göstermez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, hükümdarı halk üzerinde emir ve yasak koyan yönetici olarak tanımlar; hükümranlık, ülke, halk üzerindeki siyaset ve özellikle ilahi mutlak egemenlik bu kamusal yönetim çekirdeğinde birleşir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, belirli bir malın kişisel sahipliğinden ve ilahi haberci varlığın adından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hükümdar ve hükümranlık çekirdeği korunur; ülke, mutlak ilahi egemenlik ve birini hükümdar yapma kullanımları kendi biçim ve kalıplarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir hükümdarın halk üzerinde emir, yasak ve yönetim yetkisi kullanmasıyla kurulan kamusal hükümranlıktır. Bu alan hükümdarı, yönetim gücünü, hükmedilen ülkeyi ve ilahi bağlamda mutlak egemenliği kapsar.

facets.statement: Hükümdar, halk üzerinde emir ve yasak koyarak kamusal yönetim yetkisi kullanır.
Hükümranlık, yöneticinin halkı ve ülkesindeki etkili yönetim alanını kapsar.
İlahi bağlamda bütün varlık üzerindeki mutlak ve kalıcı egemenlik anlatılır.
Bir topluluk bir kişiyi başına geçirerek onu hükümdar konumuna getirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu alanı halk üzerinde emir ve yasakla işleyen yönetim gücü etrafında toplar; hükümdar, hükümranlık, ülke ve ilahi mutlak egemenlik aynı kamusal yetki ekseninin farklı görünümleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yönetici kişiyi, halk üzerindeki hüküm gücünü ve bu gücün ülkesini birlikte temsil eder.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bütün örnekleri evlilik akdinin kurulması çevresinde toplar: birinin evlendirilmesi, bu akde tanıklık edilmesi ve erkeğin kadınla evlenmesi aynı sözleşmesel olayın farklı katılımcı görünümleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kullanım mal sahipliği veya insanı köleleştirme değil, yalnız evlilik akdi ve evlenme bağlamıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım evlilik akdiyle sınırlıdır; ad biçimindeki akit ve kadınla evlenmeyi bildiren kalıp ayrı yüzler olarak korunur, çıplak sahiplik anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: İki kişi arasında evlilik bağını sözleşmeyle kurmak veya bu akdin gerçekleşmesidir. Kullanım, birini evlendirmeyi, evlilik akdine tanıklığı ve bir erkeğin bir kadınla evlenmesini kapsar.

facets.statement: Evlilik bağı, tarafları birbirine bağlayan bir akitle kurulur.
Bir kişi iki tarafın evlilik akdini kurarak onları evlendirir.
Evlilik akdinin yapıldığı tören veya ona tanıklık etme olayı adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu dalı evlilik akdinin kurulması olarak ortaklaştırır; evlendiren kişi, evlenen kişi ve akde tanıklık edenler aynı sözleşmesel olayın farklı katılımcılarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir işin ayakta kalmasını ve düzgün işlemesini sağlayan temel dayanağı açıkça tanımlar; kalbin beden için örnek verilmesi bu genel bağımlılık ilişkisinin özel bir uygulamasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal dayanak olan unsuru belirtir; nesnenin kendi iç sıkılığı veya sahiplik ilişkisi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız dayanak bildiren belirtili kalıplarda geçerlidir; kökün çıplak biçimine genel bir temel veya öz anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin, düzenin veya bedenin ayakta kalmasını, düzgün işlemesini ve tamamlanmasını sağlayan temel dayanak unsurudur. Kalbin beden için bu işlevi görmesi verilen başlıca örnektir.

facets.statement: Bir unsur, daha büyük bir işin veya düzenin dayandığı ve onun düzgün işlemesini sağlayan temeldir.
Bu dayanak, işin doğruluğunu, sürekliliğini ve tamamlanmasını sağlayan belirleyici koşul olur.
Kalp, bedenin işleyişinin kendisine dayandığı temel unsur olarak gösterilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak açıklaması, bir işin kendisine dayandığı ve onun düzgün kalmasını sağlayan temel unsurdur; kalbin bedenle ilişkisi bu bağımlılık yapısını somutlaştırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yol ve vadi için orta kısmı açıkça verir, ancak vadi kullanımında sınır, yol kullanımında ise ana veya büyük bölüm de aktarılır. Bu yüzden dal yalnız geometrik orta nokta diye daraltılmamalı, yerin ortası, ana kesimi veya bağlama göre sınırı olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım yol ve vadi kalıplarıyla sınırlıdır; her nesnenin genel ortası anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yolun ortası veya ana kesimi, vadinin ortası veya sınırı ve yerleşimin merkezi yalnız belgelenmiş biçim ve kalıplarda korunur.

concept_map.definition: Yolun, vadinin veya yerleşimin bağlama göre orta, ana ya da büyük kesimidir; vadi kullanımında sınır da bu adlandırmaya katılır. Söyleyişe göre bu kesim izlenecek bir güzergâh veya uzak durulacak bir yer olabilir.

facets.statement: Bir yolun veya vadinin orta ya da ana kesimi belirli bir kalıpla adlandırılır.
Vadi için orta kesimin yanında sınır, yol için ise büyük bölüm açıklaması da verilir.
Aynı biçim bir yerleşimin orta veya büyük kesimi için de kullanılır.
Bağlama göre kişi bu ana kesimi izlemeye ya da ondan uzak durmaya yönlendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yolun orta kesiminde birleşir; toplu ifade ayrıca yolun ana veya büyük bölümünü, vadinin orta ya da sınır kesimini ve yerleşimin merkezini kapsayan bağlama bağlı bir çeşitlilik gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi suyu yalnız içecek olarak değil, yolcunun veya topluluğun işini yürütebilmesini ve geçimini sürdürebilmesini sağlayan belirleyici kaynak olarak sunar. Bu nedenle dal, suyun kendisi ile suyun işleri ayakta tutan dayanak oluşunu birlikte korumalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam suyu yaşamsal ve düzen kurucu kaynak sayan kalıplara bağlıdır; her türlü soyut dayanağa genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız suyun yolcu veya topluluk için işleri yürütme ve yaşamı sürdürme aracı olduğunu bildiren kalıplaşmış söyleyişlere bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Su, yolcunun veya bir topluluğun işini denetim altında tutmasını, konaklamasını ve geçimini sürdürmesini sağlayan temel kaynaktır. Suyun bulunmaması bu yeterliğin yokluğu, çok sayıda su kaynağı ise güçlü yaşam imkânı olarak anlatılır.

facets.statement: Su, yolcunun veya topluluğun işlerini yürütebilmesini sağlayan temel kaynaktır.
Su kaynakları konaklama, geçim ve topluluk düzeninin sürmesini mümkün kılar.
Suyun yokluğu çaresizlik, çok sayıda su kaynağı ise geniş yaşam imkânı olarak ifade edilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar suyu, yolcunun veya topluluğun işlerini yürütüp yaşamını sürdürebilmesinin temel şartı olarak açıklar; tekil su varlığı ile topluluğa ait çok sayıdaki kaynak aynı işlevsel çekirdeğe bağlanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hayvan topluluklarında önden gidip diğerlerinin izlediği canlıyı açıkça içerir, fakat binek kullanımında önderlik canlı bir bireyden çok hayvanın ön ayakları ve yönlendirici kısmına yüklenir. Dal bu iki gerçekleşmeyi tek bir canlı önder imgesine indirgememelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu alan hayvanlarla sınırlı önden gitme ve yönlendirmedir; insanlar üzerindeki siyasi yönetim değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız arı topluluğu, binek hayvanı, deve ve koyun sürüsüyle kurulan kalıplarda geçerlidir; genel liderlik anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir hayvan topluluğunda önden gidip geri kalanların izlediği önder canlı veya bir binek hayvanını önden yönelten beden bölümüdür. Arı topluluğunun önderi, sürünün öncüsü ve bineğin ön ayakları ile yönlendirici kısmı bu kalıba bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Hayvanlar bağlamında önde bulunan unsur, geri kalanların hareketini yönlendirir.
Arı topluluğunda önde gelen ve topluluğu yönlendiren canlı adlandırılır.
Deve veya koyun sürüsünde önden gidip diğerlerinin izlediği öncü adlandırılır.
Binek hayvanında ön ayaklar ve hayvanın yönlendirilmesini sağlayan ön kısım adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hayvan alanında önde bulunma ve yön verme işlevini paylaşır; bu işlev arı veya sürüde izlenen canlıya, binek hayvanında ise hareketi önden taşıyan ayaklara ve yönlendirici kısma yüklenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ilahi haberci varlığın tekil adını ve çoğul sınıfını doğrudan tanımlar; ayrıca adı haber götürme ve elçilik anlamıyla ilişkilendirilen daha eski biçimlerden açıklar. Dal, mevcut zarf içinde bu sözlük biçimi ve etimolojik açıklama olarak tutulabilir; güç, özel sahiplik ya da kamusal egemenlik anlamı sayılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal sözlükte kaydedilen varlık adını ve kaynakların etimolojik açıklamasını verir; güç, sahiplik veya egemenlik anlamı vermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam çözümlenmemiştir; hiçbir çıplak kök anlamı varsayılmaz ve kavram yalnız kaynakta açıklanan ad ile etimolojik tartışma düzeyinde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İlahi buyruğu veya haberi ileten haberci varlığın adıdır. Dal ayrıca kaynakların bu adı, haber götürme ve elçilik anlamıyla ilişkili daha eski biçimlerden açıklayan etimolojik kaydını kapsar.

facets.statement: Ad, ilahi haber veya buyruk ileten haberci varlığı belirtir.
Kaynaklar adın ses ve harf düzeni değişmiş daha eski biçimlerini aktarır.
Türetim, güç, sahiplik veya egemenlikten değil, haber götürme ve elçilik anlamından açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ilahi haberci varlığın adını ve çoğul sınıfını tanır; aynı zamanda adın daha eski biçimlerden ses ve harf düzeni değişerek geldiğini, bu biçimlerin de haber götürme ve elçilik anlamıyla açıklandığını ortak biçimde aktarır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözlükte kaydedilen varlık adını karşılar; onu güç, sahiplik veya egemenlik alanının bir anlamı olarak sunmaz.

error_profile.preserves: İlahi nitelik, haber iletme işlevi ve varlık türünü birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi üstte bulunup örten şey çekirdeğini gök ve tavanla verir; bulut, yağmur, bitki, atın sırtı ve her şeyin üst yanı kullanımlarını da açıkça ekler. Dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ona bağlı aktarmaları doğru ayırmaya elverişlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Gök ve üst örtü çekirdeği ile bulut, yağmur, bitki, at sırtı ve genel üst yan kullanımları ayrı kapsamlarla korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin üzerinde bulunan ve onu örten gök, tavan ya da genel üst yandır. Bu ad buluta, yukarıdan gelen yağmura, yağmurla çıkan veya yükselen bitkiye ve atın sırtına da aktarılır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin üzerinde yükselen ve onu örten gök, tavan veya üst yan anlatılır.
Üstte bulunan ve örten bulut aynı adla anılır.
Yukarıdaki kaynağından gelen yağmur aynı adla anılır.
Yağmurdan çıkan veya yerden yükselen bitkiye aynı ad aktarılır.
Atın sırtı ve genel olarak bir şeyin en üst yanı bu yüksek üst yüzey kapsamında adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gök, tavan ve üst yan anlamlarını yüksekte bulunup örtme çekirdeğinde birleştirir; bulut, yağmur, bitki ve at sırtı kullanımlarını buna bağlı uzantılar olarak verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi adı bir şeyi tanıtan gösterge olarak tanımlar; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve aynı adı ya da niteliği hak eden denklik anlamlarını açıkça bağlar. Adın anılmayı yükselttiğine ilişkin açıklama anlamın tarihsel gerekçesi olarak tutulur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dilsel adlandırma ve adla kurulan denklikle sınırlıdır; gök ya da fiziksel yükselme anlamı yalnız açıklayıcı köken bağıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ad çekirdeği; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve ad ya da nitelik bakımından denklik bildiren özel biçimlerden ayrılarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi tanıtan ad, bu adı verme veya edinme ve başka biriyle aynı adı taşıma ilişkisidir. Ayrıca aynı adı ya da niteliği hak edecek ölçüde denk olmayı anlatır; kaynaklar adlandırmayı anılmayı yükseltme düşüncesiyle açıklar.

facets.statement: Ad, bir varlığı tanıtan ve ondan söz etmeyi sağlayan söz veya anlamdır.
Birine ad verilir veya kişi kendisi için bir ad edinir ve o adla çağrılır.
İki kişi aynı adı taşıdığında birbirinin adaşı olur.
Bir kişi, aynı adı veya niteliği hak edecek ölçüde başkasının dengi sayılır.
Kaynaklar adın kökenini, adı verilen şeyin anılmasını yükseltmesi ve onu belirgin kılmasıyla açıklar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar adı bir varlığı tanıtan unsur sayar; ad verme, ad edinme, aynı adı taşıma ve ada ya da niteliğe layık denklik anlamlarını birleştirir. Adın anılmayı yükselttiği yönündeki köken açıklamasını da paylaşır.

Av hayvanını bulup avlamak üzere arama eylemi aynı alana bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi karşılıklı yarışma, övünerek boy ölçüşme ve birbirine karşı koymayı aynı dalda birleştirir; kimsenin yarışamadığı kişi ifadesi de bu karşılaştırma eksenine dayanır. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu yapıyı doğru karşılar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karşılıklı yarışma çekirdeği, övünerek boy ölçüşme, karşı koyma ve kimsenin yarışamaması bildiren özel biçimlerle karıştırılmadan verilir.

concept_map.definition: İki tarafın üstün gelmek için birbiriyle yarışması, övünerek boy ölçüşmesi veya birbirine karşı koymasıdır. Bir kimseyle hiç kimsenin yarışamaması, onun bu karşılaştırmada erişilemez üstünlüğünü bildirir.

facets.statement: İki veya daha çok taraf üstün gelmek için karşılıklı olarak yarışır.
Taraflar sahip oldukları üstünlüklerle övünerek birbirleriyle boy ölçüşür.
Taraflardan biri ötekine karşı koyar, onunla aynı düzeye gelmeye veya onu geçmeye çalışır.
Kimsenin bir kişiyle yarışamaması, o kişinin erişilemez ölçüde üstün olduğunu bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi ya da hayvanı tanınmasını sağlayacak görünür bir izle işaretleme eylemini, bu eylemin bıraktığı izi ve işaretlemede kullanılan kızgın aracı birlikte verir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, ortak fiziksel işaretleme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; zırhın alt bölümündeki süslemeyi anlatan özel tamlama yalnızca kendi sözlüksel karşılığında korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi ya da hayvanı, tanınmasını veya ayırt edilmesini sağlayan kalıcı ve görünür bir fiziksel iz oluşturacak biçimde işaretlemektir; iz yakma, kulak kesme ya da çentikleme yoluyla bırakılabilir. Anlam alanı, oluşan işareti ve özellikle hayvanı işaretlemeye yarayan kızgın aracı da kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesne veya hayvan üzerinde onu tanıtmaya ve başkalarından ayırmaya yarayan görünür bir fiziksel iz oluşturulur.
İşaret, kızgın araçla yakılarak, kulağın bir bölümü kesilerek veya çentik açılarak bırakılabilir.
Eylemin sonucunda kalan tanıtıcı iz de aynı anlam alanında adlandırılır.
Özellikle hayvanlara bu izi koymak için kullanılan kızgın işaretleme aracı da bu dala bağlıdır.
